component.name: Claude
component.summary: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Grok in one native window

description.p: A native elementary OS client of the T3 Code server: one window drives Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Grok threads, with your local Claude Code transcripts as the offline view.

Pair once with the server, pick a provider, model and permission mode, and watch turns stream in: assistant text, commands, diffs and permission prompts you answer inline. A Usage page shows every plan window with its reset countdown; Repos and Issues pages feed the unattended runner from a GitHub backlog. One process, about 60 MB, no CPU at idle.
First release: T3 Code client with pairing, threads, composer, permission prompts, usage, repos and diagnostics; offline Claude Code transcripts.
